name: gpt-pilot
setup: . scripts/env.sh && mkdir -p "$ENV/tiktoken" && env -u RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/tiktoken" "$PY" -c "import tiktoken; tiktoken.get_encoding('cl100k_base')"
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/tiktoken" PYTHONPATH=. $PY -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/
notes: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs `poetry install --with=dev` then `poetry run pytest` on Python 3.9 and 3.12; I used 3.12 (got 3.12.15). Poetry isn't used: deps come from the repo's pinned requirements.txt (openai==1.40.6, anthropic==0.39.0, groq==0.6.0, httpx==0.27.0, tiktoken==0.8.0, ...) plus the dev group from pyproject (resolved to pytest 8.4.2, pytest-asyncio 0.23.8, pytest-cov 5.0.0, pytest-timeout 2.4.0). The package is NOT installed (poetry-core project); code is imported from the working copy via PYTHONPATH=. (pyproject also sets pytest pythonpath=["."]), so `reinstall` is empty. pyproject addopts already adds `-ra -q --cov=core --timeout 10`, so test_cmd does not add another -q (with -qq the final 'N passed' summary line disappears and parse_counts reads nothing) and passes --no-cov so coverage doesn't write a .coverage file into the repo copy or print a big report. Offline detail: tiktoken.get_encoding('cl100k_base') runs at import time in core/llm/*.py and downloads the BPE file on first use, which killed collection of 9 test modules when the network was denied. The third setup step prefetches it into $ENV/tiktoken (setup is allowed network), and test_cmd points TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR there. Nothing deselected. The 10 skips are the repo's own: 3 tests/integration/llm modules skip unless INTEGRATION_TESTS is set (those are the only tests that would call real LLM APIs), plus 7 unconditional/'Temporary' skips. Unit LLM tests (tests/llm/test_openai.py) patch AsyncOpenAI. Baseline was taken with RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY unset and outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed). Two runs gave identical counts: 262 passed, 10 skipped in 3.77s and 4.09s; exit 0. git status in the repo copy was clean after both runs. I rebuilt from scratch into a second env (gpt-pilot-check) using the setup commands as written: identical uv pip freeze, and 262 passed, 10 skipped in 4.14s.
